summary: Apps can download a file to disk with progress and cancel through the URLSession counterpart. A pure managed download queue (springboard/ui/src/managed_download.rs) models scheduling while the app is not running, but no shell service drives it yet; there is no app-store-hosted asset service.

features.feature: System update download with size and hash check
features.apple: not part of the framework; closest system-side analogue
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/background_download.rs (DownloadSpec, stage: size and SHA-256 check, .part staging, rename); springboard/src/shell/update.rs (download(), springboard.part, verify then rename), springboard/updated/src
features.note: DownloadSpec and stage give apps the shell's size, digest and .part sequence for payloads they supply, tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-os-03.rs. Gap: the SDK performs no transfer and has no background scheduling or resume.

Incoming nearby transfers stage in a hidden .share-*.part file and are renamed to their final name only after the SHA-256 matches. The staging path is a shell detail and is never exposed to apps, so there is no SDK surface to build.
